name: 24gamerated
description: Real-time multiplayer 24 card game with accounts, Elo-rated 1v1 matchmaking, friend challenges, guest rooms, and a solo training arena.

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:client"
scripts.migrate: npm run build:shared && npm run build:server && npm run migrate --workspace=server
